verdict.rationale: Data export and leaving is a fair axis for a registrar, but the evidence documents no data-export feature, no open-format export, and no outbound transfer process. The docs cover transferring domains in, unlocking domains, and disabling auto-renew. Those are adjacent controls, and the Registrar API is only a developer building block, so neither counts as an export or exit capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
